name: Question 4
problem:
Consider the following initial value problem:

$$
{y}^{′}={e}^{x}-3xy,\,y(-2)=3
$$

The **implicit** Euler method is applied with step size $Δx=1.$ 
Find the general formula for the new $y$ value, ${y}_{\text{new}},$ in terms of the new value ${x}_{\text{new}}$ and the current value $y.$
worked_solution:
For an initial value problem

$$
{y}^{′}=f(x,y),\,{y}_{0}=y({x}_{0}),
$$

the implicit Euler method with step size $Δx$ is given by

$$
Δy={y}_{\text{new}}^{′}\cdot Δx,
$$

with ${y}_{\text{new}}^{′}=f({x}_{\text{new}},{y}_{\text{new}})$ evaluated at the next $x$ and $y$ values.

In general, $Δy$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & ={y}_{\text{new}}^{′}\cdot Δx \\  & =({e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}})\cdot 1 \\  & ={e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}}.\end{aligned}
$$

We substitute this into ${y}_{\text{new}}=y+Δy$ and solve for the general formula for ${y}_{\text{new}}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}-3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}} \\ {y}_{\text{new}}+3{x}_{\text{new}}{y}_{\text{new}} & =y+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}} \\ {y}_{\text{new}}(1+3{x}_{\text{new}}) & =y+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}} \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =\frac{y+{e}^{{x}_{\text{new}}}}{1+3{x}_{\text{new}}}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 4
?

Consider the following initial value problem: y′=ex−3xy,y(−2)=3 The implicit Euler method is applied with step size Δx=1. Find the general formula for the new y value, ynew, in terms of the new value xnew and the current value y.

a
ynew=y+exnew1+3xnew
b
ynew=y+exnew1+3y
c
ynew=y+exnew−3xnewy
d
ynew=y+exnew−3y
e
ynew=y+exnew1−3xnew
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

For an initial value problem y′=f(x,y),y0=y(x0), the implicit Euler method with step size Δx is given by Δy=ynew′⋅Δx, with ynew′=f(xnew,ynew) evaluated at the next x and y values.

In general, Δy is given by

Δy=ynew′⋅Δx=(exnew−3xnewynew)⋅1=exnew−3xnewynew.

We substitute this into ynew=y+Δy and solve for the general formula for ynew:

ynew=y+Δyynew=y+exnew−3xnewynewynew+3xnewynew=y+exnewynew(1+3xnew)=y+exnewynew=y+exnew1+3xnew
